githubReview.reason: The connected GitHub account owns PR #78, so GitHub correctly rejected a formal REQUEST_CHANGES review. The exact findings were posted as a non-approving COMMENT review and cannot satisfy the independent-review gate.

blockingFindings.title: Ownership enforcement does not enforce the active claim lock
blockingFindings.detail: classify_changed_paths authorizes from mutable missionPathPolicies and does not intersect actual changes with the active claim exclusivePaths, worker identity, or claimed branch. A candidate can expand its own policy and pass while changing paths absent from the durable claim.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Bind ownership to the exact durable active claim, enforce head-branch equality or an explicit completed transfer/grant, and prevent candidate-head policy edits from self-authorizing their own diff.

blockingFindings.title: Accepted and merged-main delivery states can be fabricated
blockingFindings.detail: validate_record checks only syntactic commit/tree strings and non-empty evidence. It does not verify dependencies, evidence existence or hashes, settled exact-head CI, independent review, mission acceptance gates, authorization, or protected-main ancestry. mergedMainCommit is only required to be non-empty.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Add fail-closed acceptance authorization and live protected-main verification with negative tests for unmet dependencies, fabricated evidence, absent review, red or pending CI, and fake main identities.

blockingFindings.title: Append-only delivery history is globally writable
blockingFindings.detail: delivery records are classified as common generated paths, allowing any mission to add, modify, rename, or delete another mission's history as GENERATOR_OWNED. The implementation does not prove canonical generator provenance or immutable base-tree history, and same-second record ties are not causally ordered.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Enforce add-only base-tree semantics, mission/task ownership, immutable prior records, canonical generator provenance, and deterministic tie resolution.

nextAction: Worker J must repair P78-C-001 through P78-C-003, obtain execution approval for all exact-head workflows, publish ownership and review-impact artifacts, and request a fresh exact-head review from a genuinely independent GitHub identity.
